$comment: Single source of truth for file ownership. Read by sync.mjs, vendor.mjs, check.mjs and the docs. Paths are repo-relative globs. A path that matches no layer is treated as project-owned.

agentic.description: Owned by this template. sync.mjs may overwrite these paths in a spawned project.

vendored.description: Owned by an upstream project. Not shipped by the template: installed per project at the version pinned in vendor.json (checked by vendor.mjs verify), never edited in place. Customisations go in _bmad/custom.

project.description: Owned by the spawned project. Never touched by sync.

seeded.description: Copied once at spawn time, then owned by the project. Sync never overwrites them.
